title: Production Hardening & Smooth Operation
principles: Do not modify frozen V7.7 baseline.
Human-in-the-loop remains mandatory for clinical AI.
Every runtime-mutating gate must have rollback.
Use disposable infrastructure for destructive/recovery tests.
Evidence and hashes required before advancing gates.

phases.name: Production Operations Baseline
phases.goal: Lock V7.7 parent and production operational baseline.

phases.name: Observability, Logging & Backup Readiness
phases.goal: Make faults visible and ensure backup readiness before restart/recovery testing.

phases.name: Controlled Restart, Recovery & Rollback
phases.goal: Prove graceful API/UI restart, DB reconnect, startup ordering and rollback.

phases.name: Performance, Latency & Concurrency
phases.goal: Measure API/UI responsiveness and concurrent read workload without compromising safety.

phases.name: End-to-End UX & Operational Smoothness
phases.goal: Validate core workflows, navigation, responsiveness, browser/mobile behavior and user-facing error handling.

phases.name: Backup Restore & Data Integrity Acceptance
phases.goal: Prove backup restoration only on disposable infrastructure and validate complete data integrity.

phases.name: Final Operational Acceptance & V7.8 Freeze
phases.goal: Run integrated acceptance, stabilization and freeze V7.8.
